full_judgment:
2. The facts, relevant for disposal of this petition, are that the petitioners herein as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No.46 of 2001 in the Court of the Senior Assistant Judge, Babugonj, Barisal for declaration that they are the Teachers of Shahid Afsar Uddin Registered Primary School and also for mandatory injunction regarding their salary of Government portion is to be given to them and also for declaration of the fact that the defendants are not the teachers of the said school stating, inter alia, that the school in question was established in the year 1975 and at that time, late Flight Sergeant retired Faizul Haque, Former Member of the Parliament, was the founder and president of the executive committee of the said school and the school was registered on 24.09.1980 vide registered deed No.1038/3. At the time of establishment of the school, 45.50 decimals land from Plot Nos.1180, 1245, 1172, 1262 of SA Khatian No.7 and .20 decimals land from present plot No.1249 of SA Khatian No.122 in total .65 decimals land were transferred vide registered gift Deed No.750 in the name of the school in question and subsequently in the year 2000 with the grant of the Government a new school building was built on Plot No.1249. Plaintiff No.1 joined as a Headmaster in the year of 1975 and the plaintiff Nos.2, 3 and 4 joined as an Assistant Teacher in the years, 1980, 1987 and 1999 respectively. The 1st president of executive committee of the school died in the year 1993, but the then secretary of the said committee, Sayed Jafor Ahmed, declared himself as the president of the said school in place of Flight Sergeant, Fazlul Haque, in the year 1987 and appointed defendant Nos.4, 5, 7 and 8 as Teachers of the said school. It is also stated that after death of president, Fazlul Haque, the then president of the commit-tee, the school had been managing by 11(eleven) members school committee and Mr. Habibur Rahman was legally elected as the president in the year 1994 and in this regard, plaintiff No.1 filed a complaint before the Deputy Director of Primary Education, Khulna on 04.04.1991 against Sayed Jafor Ali, the then secretary of the committee and getting the complain the Divisional Deputy Director on 06.05.1991 sent a letter to Barisal District Selection Committee to resolve the dispute. The said committee on 12.05.1991 and 16.09.1991 sitting in the office of B.M. College Barisal, considered all the relevant papers and documents recommended for the salary of govt. The portion of plaintiff Nos.1 and 2 along with one Azahar Hossain and plaintiff No.4 which was effective from 01.07.1994 to 31.12.1994, and thereafter, plaintiff Nos.1 and 2 drawn the allowance money, but plaintiff No.4 did not draw the allowance(money). Plaintiff No.1 from the beginning of the said school, plaintiff No.2 from the year 1980 and plaintiff Nos.3 and 4 later on joined in the said school and though defendant Nos.5, 7 and 8 were shown as teachers of the said school from 1987. Although defendant Nos.4, 7, 8 claimed themselves as the teachers under the counter committee formed by defendant No.13 indeed they never served as teachers in the new school building established on Plot No.1249 and the key of the said new school building was handed over to plaintiff No.1 which reflects from the enquiry report submitted by the Director (compulsory), Primary Education, Dhaka. Defendant Nos.5, 7 and 8 are not MPO enlisted teachers, on the other hand, plaintiff Nos.1 and 2 were the MPO enlisted teachers but due to some allegations against them, they were deprived of the government allowance. Moreover, defendant No.9 issued letters dated 07.04.2001 and 04.04.2001 for appointing new teachers and to take back the government allowances from plaintiff Nos.1 and 2 which were taken by plaintiff Nos.1 and 2 during 01.01.1995 to July, 2001. Being aggrieved and dissatisfied with the letters issued by defendant No.9, the plaintiffs filed this suit. 

 14. It is admitted by all the parties that one Syed Zafor Ali gifted out his land measuring and area of .65½ acre from Plot Nos.1180/ 1245/ 1172/ 1262 and 1249 appertaining two SA Khatian being Nos.07 and 122 by a Register Arponnama dated 15.01.1980 and Sahid Afsar Uddin Registered Primary school were being established on the Plot No.1245 and initially plaintiff No.1 and 2 along with Isahaq Ali, Azahar Hossain, Syed Abul Hossain and Mozibul Hague were appointed as teacher of aforesaid primary school. It is also admitted that SB account being No.10201 has been opened in Sonali Bank Limited, Corporate Branch, Sadar Road, Barishal in the name of such school after fulfillment of all condition of registration and accordingly on 24.09.1980 the school was register.
